method: Retrospective rule-based illustration: 7 equally weighted monthly market tests, each positive test adds 10 percentage points to a 30% growth floor (range 30–100%). Uses only market prices observable at each month end, and 91-day lookbacks. No trading costs, tax, dividends, or rebalancing friction. Not the historical CPW recommendation or an independently validated backtest.
source: Yahoo Finance adjusted close history (dividends/splits adjusted where provided)
